title: FIFO Read Pointer Missing Reset
description: The write pointer is correctly reset to 0 on rst_n, but the read pointer has no reset branch; after power-on rd_ptr is X, making empty/full flags unreliable until the first read occurs.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [XZ] rd_ptr=4'bxxxx at first posedge clk; empty flag unreliable
expected_root_cause: The read pointer rd_ptr is never assigned in the reset branch of the always_ff block; it retains an unknown (X) value from power-on, causing the empty and full comparisons to produce X results.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [XZ] rd_ptr=4'bxxxx at first posedge clk; empty flag unreliable
success_log: rd_ptr=4'h0 after reset. Empty asserted correctly; first read returns valid data.
fix_replacement:
always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
  if (!rst_n) begin wr_ptr <= 4'h0; rd_ptr <= 4'h0; end
  else begin
    if (wr_en && !full)  wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 1;
    if (rd_en && !empty) rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 1;
  end
end
